title: Administration Metrics Framework — Future Measurement Preparation
purpose: Prepare the measurement model for May Administration Portal metrics. The admin platform is a P0-P2 deliverable (S830-S910). This framework defines what will be measured once the platform is operational, preventing ad-hoc metric design later.

platform_readiness.description: The May Administration Portal (7 modules, 5 roles) is specified in SESSION203_ADMIN_PLATFORM_SPEC.json and SESSION203_ROLE_MODEL.json but is not yet built. S350 establishes the measurement framework so that when the platform goes live (P0 at S830), metrics collection has a pre-defined schema.

AM-001_student_challenges.label: Student Challenge Metrics
AM-001_student_challenges.description: When students challenge question content, the platform must track the challenge lifecycle.

metrics_to_measure.challenge_count: Total challenges submitted, by question, by domain, by challenge type
metrics_to_measure.challenge_resolution_time: Time from challenge submission to resolution. p50, p95, p99 by challenge type.
metrics_to_measure.backlog: Open challenges by age bucket: <1 week, 1-4 weeks, 1-3 months, >3 months
metrics_to_measure.v2_target: <7 days average resolution time for UPHELD challenges. <30 days for all challenges.

AM-002_question_investigations.label: Question Investigation Metrics
AM-002_question_investigations.description: When a question is flagged for investigation (by student challenge, scan finding, or agent escalation), the platform tracks the investigation lifecycle.

metrics_to_measure.investigations_opened: Count of investigations opened per session, by trigger source (scan, student, agent)
metrics_to_measure.investigations_closed: Count of investigations closed per session
metrics_to_measure.mean_resolution_time: Average time from investigation opened to closed, by trigger source
metrics_to_measure.escalation_rate: Rate at which investigations escalate from Content Admin to Certification Reviewer to Governance Admin
metrics_to_measure.recurrence_rate: Rate at which closed investigations are re-opened for the same question
metrics_to_measure.v2_target: Investigations resolved within 1 session for HIGH severity, 3 sessions for MEDIUM, 5 sessions for LOW

AM-003_session_navigation.label: Session Navigation Metrics
AM-003_session_navigation.description: The Session Registry module provides bidirectional navigation (Question→Session→Recommendation). Track how users navigate this graph.

metrics_to_measure.page_views: Total page views by module, by role
metrics_to_measure.search_queries: Search query volume, by type (QID, compound-key, domain, session, recommendation)
metrics_to_measure.drill_down_depth: Average navigation depth — how many linked objects does a user traverse in one session? (e.g., Question → 3 Sessions → 2 Recommendations = depth 3)
metrics_to_measure.most_common_navigation_paths: Top navigation path sequences (e.g., Session → Recommendation → Question → Session)
metrics_to_measure.v2_target: Navigation paths of 2+ hops should be common — the deep-linking is the feature

AM-004_resolution_times.label: Resolution Time Metrics
AM-004_resolution_times.description: End-to-end resolution time for various platform workflows. Tracked by issue type and severity.

by_issue_type.student_challenge: p50, p95, p99 resolution time in calendar days
by_issue_type.question_investigation: p50, p95, p99 resolution time in sessions
by_issue_type.recommendation_execution: p50, p95, p99 time from OPEN to CLOSED in sessions
by_issue_type.certification_batch: Time from READY to CERTIFIED per batch in sessions
by_issue_type.defect_remediation: Time from REMEDIATE to READY per item in sessions

metrics_to_measure.v2_target: CRITICAL: ≤1 session. HIGH: ≤2 sessions. MEDIUM: ≤5 sessions. LOW: ≤10 sessions.

AM-005_admin_workload.label: Administrative Workload Metrics
AM-005_admin_workload.description: Track the human/machine workload of administering the certification pipeline. Framework v2 should reduce admin workload.

metrics_to_measure.actions_per_role_per_session: Number of admin actions performed by each role in each session
metrics_to_measure.automated_vs_manual_ratio: Actions performed automatically by platform vs. actions requiring human input
metrics_to_measure.v2_target: Administrative workload should decrease as automation increases through Phase 1→2→3. Target: 50% reduction in manual admin actions by Phase 3.

measurement_implementation.label: Implementation Guidance
measurement_implementation.description: These metrics are placeholders until the May Administration Platform is operational. When the platform goes live at S830, the measurement infrastructure must:
requirements: Log every admin action with: timestamp, acting_user_role, action_type, target_object_id (QID/REC-ID/session), outcome
Aggregate logs per session in the GOVERNANCE_REPORT administration section
Compute AM-001 through AM-005 metrics at every session Tend
Trend metrics across sessions to detect workload changes as Framework v2 phases progress
Compare v2 admin workload against v1 baseline (estimated from session summaries and agent spawn counts)
measurement_implementation.v1_baseline_note: Framework v1 has no administration platform — all admin work is manual through agent-spawn operations. The v1 admin workload can be estimated retrospectively from session summaries: average ~19 agent-spawns per session, of which ~30-40% were administrative (governance checks, backup verification, session coordination) rather than content review.
